sm: Shane Gillis talks about the stress of online backlash after his Saturday Night Live monologue. He describes getting chest pain during a set, and a blood test later showing a severe cortisol spike, and says hate online affects you physically. He explains he deleted Instagram and Twitter right away this time and feels better for it. He says the most disappointing part was comics and club staff making lists against him, though he describes the people talking badly as mediocre, middling careers. He says his monologue was a solid C minus with no controversy, mostly him calling himself fat, and jokes about skin tight shorts and joggers. He ends with a story about a sketch idea and the backlash over it.
